links.note: Asks what else can reach a mutually acceptable settlement instead of fighting; the story's own answer is the bargain in 31785 - diving lessons traded for wrestling training, which Suraj himself calls fair. 31786 is the friendship that follows the bargain, not the means of settling.

Turns on a fight realised afterwards to have been unnecessary and futile; 31774 is the futility beat - five minutes of frenzied, unscientific struggle, neither boy victorious, both still holding their titles. 31772 is the blow that starts it.

Asks why some people need to prove they are better than others; 31770 is that need enacted - the stranger plants his feet, announces his rank as if it settles everything and will not take answers from villagers. 31783 is Suraj's boast about his own future strength, which is ambition rather than a claim over someone else.
